116 separate bite marks. Judging from the wound measurements, there were 50 different snakes involved, mostly copperheads And rattlers.

Fox Mulder

Yeah, with a pistol in his hand. He fired six shots into the floorboards, into the passenger seat, even into his own right kneecap. The windows were shut And the doors were locked.

Dana Scully

But what happened to all the snakes?

Fox Mulder

No one seems to know that. There was not a scale found. I just got off the phone with a herpetologist at the smithsonian, And he's stumped, especially because these rattlesnakes tend to hibernate in winter.

Dana Scully

So you think that mr. Chirp was murdered.

Fox Mulder

It certainly would appear that way, but the question is how. There's no physical evidence at all-- no tire tracks, no footprints. I can't see how anyone could've accomplished this. Then you gotta ask yourself why. Why would anybody use poisonous snakes as a murder weapon?

Dana Scully

Maybe it's symbolic. I mean, serpents And religion have gone hand in hand. They've represented the temptation of eve, original sin. They've been feared And hated throughout history, as they've been thought to embody satan-- to serve evil itself.

Fox Mulder

Maybe these ones actually do.

Dana Scully

These particular serpents actually were serving evil? Are you gonna type that on our travel request?

Fox Mulder

No. But at the very least this case does seem to center around religion, And you're not the only one to think that, by the way.

Reverend Mackey

But, again, it is not for me to judge. I will say, however, that both Jared And Gracie... Were persecuted by the members of their former church. All this animus... Stems from their church leader, enoch O'Connor.

Dana Scully
